notes:
Summary: Palomar builds a low-latency code review and assisted-dev product for retail banking platforms. They require an enterprise-grade IDE copilot that can run in a private VPC or on-prem with strict audit trails and configurable retention. Key asks: streaming token-level responses inside their IDE (VS Code plugin), per-route model pinning (staging/prod), and immutable audit logs of suggestions and acceptance/rejection events.

What they told us: "We cannot accept any possibility of source code leaving our VPC — even transiently." CTO, 2026-02-18. Wants HSM/KMS integration and retention controls tied to legal hold.

Technical constraints: need <50ms additional latency for inline completions at 95th percentile; support for batching for background indexing and reranking; ability to pin a specific model build and automatically fallback to a smaller quantized variant during traffic spikes. Requires SAML SSO with attribute mappings for teams/orgs, audit logs export to their SIEM (Splunk), and signed attestations for security review.

Procurement/Legal: Procurement wants vendor-supplied SOC2 report and a redline on the data residency/processing clause. Palomar's legal is pushing for explicit deletion SLAs and guarantees about cache lifecycle.

Commercial: Initial PoC target is 6-8 engineer seats plus a sandbox cluster for ~12 weeks. Roadmap would expand to 300+ seats if PoC passes.
